name: Kshitij Ashok Sawarkar
title: Forward Deployed Systems & Autonomous Robotics Engineer
summary: Autonomous systems and forward-deployed automation engineer with an M.Tech in Control and Instrumentation from MNNIT Allahabad and a B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from RCOEM Nagpur. Operates at the intersection of embedded hardware, deterministic edge runtimes, real-time computer vision, and industrial systems automation. Lead author of peer-reviewed edge-perception research published in IEEE Xplore (Document ID: 10627276). Proven track record of architecting production-grade client-side engines executing under 50ms latency (npl-automation.pages.dev), software-defined radio (SDR) spectral sensing pipelines for UAV RF classification, and ROS2 embedded robotics control stacks.

highlights: Combinatorial Schema Engine: Architected and deployed a production client-side engine (npl-automation.pages.dev) on Cloudflare Pages, automating multi-tier Finished Goods (FG) code generation and New Product Launch (NPL) parameter trees across dynamic seater variants and colorways.

flagship_projects.name: HiWonder MentorPi M1 Autonomous Robotics Platform

Solved combinatorial explosion bottlenecks using recursive client-side parsing algorithms, compressing 72+ operational hours of manual ERP reconciliation into deterministic sub-minute execution with sub-50ms latency.

flagship_projects.name: Real-Time Drone Detection & RF Signal Classification
highlights: Built an automated edge spectral sensing pipeline intercepting communication bursts between commercial UAV flight controllers and Ground Control Stations (GCS) across 2.4 GHz and 5.8 GHz ISM bands.

Configured Software-Defined Radio (SDR) hardware to stream raw I/Q signal data, applying Fast Fourier Transforms (FFT) and spectrogram processing to isolate low-power transmission spikes against ambient radio noise.
Trained lightweight neural classification models to differentiate drone telemetry from Wi-Fi/Bluetooth interference with sub-second classification latency.

flagship_projects.name: Smart Shopping Cart: Real-Time Edge Object Detection
highlights: Curated a custom retail dataset and fine-tuned YOLOv5 models for multi-class edge detection running directly on ARM-constrained Raspberry Pi hardware.
Implemented INT8 model parameter quantization and cache optimization to balance thermal throttling limits against frames-per-second (FPS) throughput.
Designed an OpenCV pipeline executing local billing logic with zero server dependencies, guaranteeing full offline operational readiness.
Published as Lead Author in IEEE Xplore (Document ID: 10627276).

flagship_projects.name: Photovoltaic Sensorless Solar Tracker
highlights: Engineered a dual-axis solar tracking algorithm that eliminates external light-dependent resistors (LDRs) and auxiliary optical sensors.

Utilized the intrinsic photovoltaic voltage and current characteristics of the solar panel itself as the diagnostic light-intensity sensor, dynamically calculating maximum power point vectors to actuate motor positioners with minimal component overhead.
Built closed-loop control algorithms ensuring robust tracking performance in high-dust and extreme industrial environmental conditions.

flagship_projects.name: Industrial Plant-Floor Production Micro-Utilities

Processed batch image renaming and sequencing completely in-browser with zero upload bandwidth or cloud storage overhead, cutting onboarding latency by >80%.

flagship_projects.name: Gas Detection Safety Interlock System

Programmed analog-to-digital threshold comparison logic, automatic alarm actuation, and sensor calibration routines to trigger emergency alerts under volatile gas leak scenarios.
